mapper.select: SELECT s3_path FROM S3_FILES where entity_type = #{entityType.value} AND entity_id = #{entityId} AND del_flg = false ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO S3_FILES (entity_type, entity_id, s3_key, sort_order, is_main_image, del_flg) VALUES (#{entityType.value}, #{entityId}, #{s3Key}, #{sortOrder}, #{isMainImage}, false)
mapper.update: UPDATE S3_FILES SET del_flg = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE entity_type = #{entityType.value} AND entity_id = #{entityId} AND del_flg = false
